design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (renewals_transfers_and_early_exit, category term).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"task": 0, "key": "env_0023_multifamily_apartment_reit/renewals_transfers_and_early_exit/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5]}. Designed to it: one prerequisite problem; the offer-line correction takes 5 factors, the renewal rent takes 5. --tasks 2 shows task 1 draws 2 prerequisite problems with factor counts [5, 5, 6].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: term_ext_offer_line_correction (tool reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766, agent) and term_ext_like_program_renewal_rent (tool sign_renewal_term_7151ccb7, user); the renewal-pricing branch of the charter (term_renewal_offer + term_create). Left for task 1: the whole early-exit branch (term_early_termination, term_fee_assessment on an exit request: concession recapture, notice shortfall, reletting fee and the resident's signing of the exit agreement), which is untouched and supports its own 3-problem tree. Transfers are excluded for both tasks because term_transfer triggers lease:lease_unit_transfer in another category; rent-change writes are excluded because term_rent_change triggers lease:lease_rent_update.
[Why a good test] The customer only says 'I want to renew for twelve months on the same program and sign today'. The scored rent hides behind a policy prerequisite she never mentions: the like-program renewal rent 'is fixed only after the offer line standing for the renewing term program is priced within the effective cap of the renewal offer rules'. The letter's line (2,311.20 = 2,140.00 x 1.08) looks correct to anyone who knows only the program cap (the baseline of the correction policy gives exactly 2,311.20), so the agent must compute the effective cap from four record-driven reductions and a rent-period method, see that the line is above it, re-issue it at 2,220.21, and only then price the renewal, whose early-renewal clock itself changes because the program now carries two lines. Difficulty = discovering the hop + reconciling tenure, payments, late fees, violations, rent changes and parking, not tool guessing (two distinct tools, each named by its own policy).
[Design thesis / chain] surface goal (renew 12 months, sign) -> prerequisite (line within effective cap?) -> core computation 1 (corrected offer rent, 5 factors over lease tenure, lease payment returns + autopay, term end month, last rent change, rent period) -> write 1 (re-issue line) -> core computation 2 (renewal rent, 5 factors over offer lines, signing date, violation notices, late fees + autopay, parking license) -> write 2 (resident signs renewal) -> terminal state: new term_offers line at 2,220.21 and a pending renewal term at 2,175.21. Depth: 2 problems in a chain. Breadth: 4 lease-ledger windows (returns 12m, late fees 12m, violations 12m, move-in tenure), a parking holding, two term histories (offers, rent changes), and the CO state test for the statutory limit.
[Base-invariant card] Step 11 subject term_renewal_offer: term_evt_renewal_offers.offer_on_current_term 'Renewal offers are delivered only on a term that is current.' evidence lease_terms.66520537-93c0-40eb-8cd2-98c95b0fd80d.status = current, correlated by term_id = the tool's term_id; term_agg_tenancy_chain has no gate (policy_scope). Step 13 subject term_create: term_agg_multi_holding.one_pending_term (no pending term on lease 4c7ba37b-8946-4f67-aaae-33c7b2f6b101: T1-T3 superseded, T4 current) bound to lease_id; term_evt_term_pricing.offer_still_open (time): anchor term_offers.offer_date of the accepted line (the re-issued line, 2026-07-20, prior_step 11), duration Standard renewal_offer_valid_days 30 calendar days counted from the day after, relation not_after, inclusive -> open through 2026-08-19; frozen 2026-07-20 satisfies it; a line dated 2026-06-19 would be one day past (negative case). term_transfer_rule and term_mtm_conversion: policy_scope (no gate on a renewal term_create). renewal_requires_current_balance: lease balance_due 0.00, no notice to vacate on T4, lease active.
[Business-object card] Target object: the Standard Lease (10-12 Months) offer line d95b546a-97c5-4185-aef2-d008ef1893be on expiring term 66520537-93c0-40eb-8cd2-98c95b0fd80d; correlation key term_id + offered_variant. Included rows: that line (the only one of its program), rent change 2e4a875a-90fa-43f2-861b-547dcda11585 on T4. Excluded: the Flexible/Extended/Long-Term lines (other programs, priced off a 12-month-equivalent of 2,150.00, within the effective cap, not re-priced), superseded terms T1-T3 (no offers). The renewal writes a new term on lease 4c7ba37b-8946-4f67-aaae-33c7b2f6b101 referencing the re-issued line; nothing is reversed or compensated.
[Factor card - offer-line correction] loyalty_cap_reduction: ladder 48+/24-47/<24 months; tenure 57 months from leases.move_in_date 2021-10-01 to line date 2026-07-02 -> 0.025; baseline 0 -> 2,264.76. standing_cap_reduction (multi-source: returns AND autopay): 0 returns in the 12-month window (near-miss: return 2025-05-06, 14 months), autopay true -> 0.005; baseline -> 2,229.12. expiry_season_cap_reduction: T4 ends 2026-09-30 -> shoulder month -> 0.0025; baseline -> 2,224.66. increase_relief_cap_reduction: rent change 2,045.00 -> 2,140.00 = 4.65% -> 0.0025; baseline -> 2,224.66. rent_period_cap_fitting (method): 304-day rent period -> prorated; baseline (cap as it stands) -> 2,236.30. All five at baseline -> 2,311.20 (the letter's figure). Cross-difficulty: lease (tenure, returns, autopay).
[Factor card - renewal rent] early_renewal_discount: 90 counted days -> 40.00; baseline 0 -> 2,195.21. early_renewal_clock_start (method): two Standard lines after the re-issue -> scheduled delivery, 90 lead days; baseline signing date (72 days -> 25.00) -> 2,182.71. violation_discount_share: one notice in 12 months (2026-02-10; near-miss 2025-06-12 at 13 months) -> 0.5; baseline 1.0 -> 2,155.21. on_time_renewal_credit (multi-source: late fees AND autopay): no late fee in window (near-miss 2025-05-09, 14 months), autopay -> 10.00; baseline -> 2,185.21. parking_bundle_credit (cross-difficulty parking): active Structured Garage Space -> 15.00; baseline -> 2,190.21. All at baseline -> 2,220.21. No stamp decides a tier: every tier is read from lease payments/charges/notices, move-in date, rent changes, offer lines or the parking license.
[Seed rationale] customers/leases: identity + move-in 2021-10-01 (tenure), CO (no statutory cap), autopay true. lease_terms T1-T4: continuous chain since move-in; T4 is the 10-month current term whose rent period is 304 days. term_rent_changes 2e4a875a-90fa-43f2-861b-547dcda11585: relief tier and rent-period start. term_offers x4: the Standard line in error plus three in-cap lines. lease_payments/charges 2025-05..2026-07: monthly autopay rent, the May 2025 returned payment with its late and NSF fees repaid by cashier's check 2025-05-12 (2,045.00 rent + 102.25 CO late fee + 20.00 CO-capped returned payment fee = 2,167.25; balance 0.00) - the near-misses for the standing reduction and the on-time credit. lease_notices: 2025-06-12 (outside) and 2026-02-10 (inside) violations. parking_licenses: garage license for the bundle credit. Removing the Standard line removes the problem; removing RC4 changes relief (0) and the rent period (from term start, same 304 days) -> result 2,224.66; removing the 2026-02-10 notice changes the share to 1.0 -> 2,155.21. No cache trap is used. Automatic clauses checked: no offer expires before frozen time (the 2026-07-02 lines are open to 2026-08-01; the re-issued line to 2026-08-19), T4 does not convert (renewal signed before 2026-09-30), no rent change is due.
[Persona design] Renata is friendly and efficient; volunteers the goal (renew now, same Standard program, twelve months, sign herself), the letter figure she saw (a fact in initial_state) and that she does not negotiate; gives phone/DOB/SSN when verification is asked, email only if asked; answers start date and program if asked; reacts passively to a correction explanation, accepts the agent's rent, signs with the details the agent gives, and closes once the renewal is confirmed pending. No mention of caps, corrections, the prerequisite, or the answer 2,175.21; no incidental request.
[Problem-tree card] Root term_ext_like_program_renewal_rent (user tool sign_renewal_term_7151ccb7). Edge -> term_ext_offer_line_correction: kind value_input, gate line_rent, form state, prerequisite sentence 'The contracted rent of a like-program renewal is fixed only after the offer line standing for the renewing term program is priced within the effective cap of the renewal offer rules.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; XX is a record-visible state (the offer line's rent vs the cap); no tool, id or code token; strength 'only after' = hard requirement, scope = the renewing program's line only. Exactly one write of this difficulty delivers an offer line (reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766), so the state names one resolving action. Derivation: sentence + records (Standard line 2,311.20 > 2,220.21) + the correction rule ('is re-issued before acceptance as a new line ... at the corrected offer rent') -> re-issue. Unresolved at opening: term_offers.d95b546a-97c5-4185-aef2-d008ef1893be.offered_rent = 2311.2 above the effective cap. Order: correction (step 11) then renewal (step 13); single chain, no parallel edge. Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 11 -> contracted_rent 2,273.70 instead of 2,175.21. user_scenario never names the correction; tools validate nothing (see tools_do_not_block).
[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, SSN) -> find_leases -> find_lease_terms(lease) -> find_term_offers(T4) -> find_term_rent_changes(T4) -> find_lease_payments -> find_lease_charges -> find_lease_notices -> find_parking_licenses -> unlock+call reissue(T4, d95b546a-97c5-4185-aef2-d008ef1893be, 2220.21, 2026-08-19) -> unlock user tool, resident calls sign_renewal(lease, tof_00bc606a27c6, 2026-10-01, 2027-09-30, 2175.21).
[Verification run] scratchpad calc.py (replays gold writes with the real tools into the handling-time world, evaluates each policy's compute, every factor baseline and skip-edge): offer correction RESULT 2220.21, factor baselines 2264.76/2229.12/2224.66/2224.66/2236.30, ALL 2311.20; renewal RESULT 2175.21, baselines 2195.21/2182.71/2155.21/2185.21/2190.21, ALL 2220.21; skipping [11] -> 2273.70. Gates: replay_tasks --task 0 REPLAY OK (14 actions, closure 48 = initial 48); check_compute --task 0 COMPUTE OK (10 factors, 5 cross, 34 branches); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK; check_extended EXTENDED OK after fixing one overwrite quote (symptom: superseded_clause not verbatim; cause: base says 'expiring term program's'; change: quote corrected; re-run OK); check_task_tools, check_grounding, check_cross_fire OK.
[Closure] term_ext_offer_line_correction -> reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766 -> computations[0] step 11 offered_rent 2220.21 -> terminal new offer line; term_ext_like_program_renewal_rent -> sign_renewal_term_7151ccb7 -> computations[1] step 13 contracted_rent 2175.21 -> pending renewal term. scope = required_documents = both policies; task_tools in first-call order. Write order = topological order of the tree.
[Two-way rule/compute sweep] Each binding that reads or chooses quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis; reverse sweep: the re-issue clause (same program and length copied by the tool; the handling date as offer date; the last acceptance date computed from the program's validity days and passed as offer_expiration_date); the 'lines for other programs are not re-priced' clause is the negative space; the statutory limit (CA 8.8 / WA 9.68) is statutory_cap + effective_cap; 'no intermediate figure is rounded' matches the single RND (with the half-up guard); the program rent adjustment sentence is capped_equivalent_rent + program_rent_adjustment; the renewal rule's 'subtracted in one step' matches result.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] Using only the published rules, the tool schemas, the persona and the find_* returns: the line of her program is 2,311.20; the effective cap is 8% - 3.5 points = 4.5%, prorated over 304 days to 3.748%; CO has no statutory cap; the Standard program has no rent adjustment, so the corrected offer rent is 2,220.21; the letter's 2,311.20 is above it, so the line is re-issued, open through 2026-08-19; after re-issue two lines -> 90 days -> 40.00 x 0.5; credits 10.00 and 15.00 -> 2,175.21; same writes and parameters as gold. No second reading found: the renewal term dates follow the base start and end rules; the offer_id is the only line most recently delivered.
[Real-conversation walk] opening: goal + letter figure; identity on request; agent reads lease, terms, offers, rent change, lease ledger, notices, parking; explains the line must be re-issued (she agrees), re-issues; states the rent 2,175.21, unlocks and hands over the signing tool; she signs with the details given; the receipt (status pending) closes the call under one frozen time; no waiting on any external event.
[Round 2 rework - audit policy_task r1, items closed] F2: the correction rule now prices the like-program line as the base renewal offer rule does - the capped 12-month-equivalent rent (in-place rent raised by the effective cap) adjusted by the program's rent adjustment with its minimum premium floor (new bindings capped_equivalent_rent, program_rent_adjustment); Standard's adjustment is 0 so 2,220.21 is unchanged; the B edge condition now reads 'no higher than the corrected offer rent'. O5: the re-issued line is open for the program's full validity days from its own date; the tool takes offer_expiration_date (2026-08-19) instead of copying 2026-08-01, so both readings of the offer-open gate coincide; new line id tof_00bc606a27c6. O8: both like-program rules are now scoped to the Flexible, Standard, Extended and Long-Term Lease programs (Short-Term lines and renewals are priced by base), so no tier collapses onto its fall-through. O4: 're-issued before acceptance' dropped from the correction rule (the dependency is stated once, in the renewal rule). O3: the signing docstring now says 'as returned by the renewal offer lookup for the expiring term' and the re-issue docstring no longer points to acceptance. O1: every rounding site adds a 0.000001 guard so RND rounds half up as the rules say; no figure of this task moves. Seed observation (i): the May-2025 late fee is now 102.25 on 2025-05-09 (CO 7-day grace; greater of 95.00 and 5% of 2,045.00; CO cap reached so no daily fees) and the returned payment fee 20.00 (CO cap), repaid 2025-05-12 with 2,167.25; both stay 14 months before the handling date, so no tier moves. Re-run: calc.py 0 [[11]] -> 2220.21 / 2175.21, factor baselines and skip-edge unchanged (2273.70).
user_scenario: You are Renata Solberg, a 39-year-old physical therapist who has lived in apartment 2-214 at Larkspur Cherry Creek in Denver since October 2021. You are calling Larkspur Resident Services because your current lease term ends on September 30 and you want to renew now, on the same Standard Lease program you are on today, this time for a full twelve months, and you would like to sign the renewal yourself during this call. You received the renewal offer letter at the start of July; the twelve-month Standard Lease line on it showed $2,311.20 a month, and you have already decided to stay. You are not interested in the shorter or longer options on that letter, and you are not asking to negotiate the rent. You speak in a friendly, efficient way and you do not know any account or reference numbers. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your mobile number 720-552-0147, your date of birth 1987-03-19 and the last four digits of your Social Security number, 2471; only if the agent asks for your email address do you give renata.solberg24@gmail.com. If the agent asks when the new term should start, you say right when the current one ends, and if asked about the length you repeat that you want twelve months on the Standard Lease program. You have not given any notice to move out and you tell the agent so only if asked. If the agent explains that the offer line has to be corrected or re-issued before you can sign, you say that is fine and let them go ahead. If the agent tells you the renewal rent will differ from the letter, you accept the figure the agent gives you without arguing, because you want to stay. When the agent hands the renewal over for you to sign, you sign it with exactly the lease, offer line, start date, end date and monthly rent the agent tells you, and you read back the confirmation you receive. Once the signed renewal comes back confirmed as pending, you thank the agent and end the call; you have no other requests.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's resident profile from the mobile number she states, returning her customer reference number and the credentials on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to this customer reference number; the profile also holds the date of birth and SSN last four used to verify her.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with the date of birth and SSN last four she states (two matching details).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any account information is discussed or changed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her lease: community state (CO), move-in date 2021-10-01 for the tenancy chain, autopay enrollment and the lease reference number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The move-in date sets the loyalty cap reduction tier, autopay feeds the standing cap reduction and the on-time renewal credit, the state decides whether a statutory cap applies, and lease_id is the renewal's lease argument.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the chain of Lease Term Agreements: the current Standard Lease term (2025-12-01 to 2026-09-30, 10 months, 2,140.00) and the superseded terms before it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The expiring term's program, end date, contracted rent and status are the base of the corrected offer rent and of the renewal rent; its end date fixes the renewal term dates and the expiry-season tier; the chain confirms no pending term exists.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the four renewal offer lines delivered 2026-07-02 on the expiring term, including the Standard Lease line at 2,311.20.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The Standard Lease line is the like-program line whose rent must be checked against the effective cap; its offer date anchors the loyalty tenure and its reference number is the line being replaced.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the rent change recorded on the expiring term (2,045.00 to 2,140.00 effective 2025-12-01).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The last rent change sets the increase-relief cap reduction tier and starts the rent period that decides how the company cap is fitted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the lease payments and returns, including the returned autopay of 2025-05-06.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The standing cap reduction depends on whether a returned payment falls fewer than 12 full months before the handling date; the May 2025 return is 14 months old and does not count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the lease ledger charges, including the late fee of 2025-05-09.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The on-time renewal credit depends on late fees dated fewer than 12 full months before the handling date; the May 2025 late fee is outside that window.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the violation notices on the lease (2025-06-12 and 2026-02-10).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The discount share is set by violation notices dated fewer than 12 full months before the handling date: only the 2026-02-10 notice counts.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the household's parking licenses: an active Structured Garage Space.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The parking bundle credit is set by the product of the active parking license.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the offer re-issue tool named by the offer-line correction policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Re-issue the Standard Lease offer line on the expiring term at the corrected offer rent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The like-program renewal rent waits on the renewing program's line being priced within the effective cap; the line of 2,311.20 exceeds it.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_id: Value 66520537-93c0-40eb-8cd2-98c95b0fd80d. Basis: the tool docstring says 'the reference number of the expiring Lease Term Agreement the offer is made on, as returned by the lease term lookup'; find_lease_terms(lease_id) returns exactly one term with status current, and it is the term the four offer lines point at (term_offers.term_id). Uniqueness: the other three terms of the lease are superseded and carry no offers; only the current term is expiring.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.offer_id: Value d95b546a-97c5-4185-aef2-d008ef1893be. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the renewal offer line being replaced, as returned by the renewal offer lookup for that term'; the correction rule re-issues 'the renewal offer line delivered on a current term for that term's own term program'. Uniqueness: of the four lines returned by find_term_offers(term_id), only one carries offered_variant 'Standard Lease (10-12 Months)', the program of the expiring term; the Flexible, Extended and Long-Term lines are other programs and are within the effective cap.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.offered_rent: Value 2220.21 (calculated). Program renewal increase cap 0.08 (Standard Lease); loyalty cap reduction 0.025 (move-in 2021-10-01 to line delivery 2026-07-02 = 57 full months, tier 48 or more); standing cap reduction 0.005 (no returned payment fewer than 12 full months before 2026-07-20 - the 2025-05-06 return is 14 months old - and autopay enrolled); expiry-season reduction 0.0025 (term ends in September); increase-relief reduction 0.0025 (last rent change 2,045.00 -> 2,140.00 = 4.65 percent); company cap 0.08 - 0.035 = 0.045; rent period 2025-12-01..2026-09-30 inclusive = 304 days < 365, so prorated 0.045 x 304/365 = 0.0374795; CO has no statutory cap; capped 12-month-equivalent rent 2,140.00 x 1.0374795 = 2,220.2061; the Standard Lease rent adjustment is 0 percent (no premium, no discount), so the program adjustment adds 0; rounded half up -> 2,220.21. Any agent applying the published rule to these rows converges on 2,220.21.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.offer_expiration_date: Value 2026-08-19. Basis: the correction rule re-issues the line 'dated the handling date and open for the program's renewal offer validity days counted from that date like any offer line'; the base term pricing rule counts 'Offer validity days ... as calendar days starting the day after the offer date, and the offer can be accepted through the last counted day'; Standard Lease renewal_offer_valid_days = 30, so 2026-07-20 + 30 days = 2026-08-19; the docstring asks for 'the last date on which the new offer line may be accepted, written YYYY-MM-DD'. Uniqueness: one handling date and one validity figure give one date; keeping the error line's 2026-08-01 is excluded by the rule sentence.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the renewal signing tool and hand it to the resident, who signs her own renewal.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Signing a renewal is the resident's own act; the agent unlocks and hands it over; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The resident signs a 12-month Standard Lease renewal from the re-issued line at the computed contracted rent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the customer's request; the like-program renewal rent policy uniquely produces contracted_rent.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.lease_id: Value 4c7ba37b-8946-4f67-aaae-33c7b2f6b101. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the resident's apartment home lease, as returned by the lease lookup'; find_leases(customer_id) returns one lease. Uniqueness: the resident holds a single lease.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.offer_id: Value tof_00bc606a27c6. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the renewal offer line being accepted, as returned by the renewal offer lookup for the expiring term'; the renewal rule prices from 'the most recently delivered offer line for the renewing term program on the expiring term'. Uniqueness: after step 11 the Standard Lease program carries two lines on the expiring term; the most recent (offer_date 2026-07-20, offered_rent 2,220.21) is the re-issued line, whose id the re-issue write returns and the renewal offer lookup lists; the 2026-07-02 line is the one posted in error.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_start_date: Value 2026-10-01. Basis: base term pricing rule 'A renewal term starts on the day after the expiring term's term_end_date (renewal_term_start_rule)'; the expiring term ends 2026-09-30 (find_lease_terms), and the resident asks to start 'right when the current one ends'. Uniqueness: a single date follows 2026-09-30.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_end_date: Value 2027-09-30. Basis: base term pricing rule 'its term_end_date follows term_end_rule: the day before the same day number term_months months after term_start_date'; the accepted line is 12 months (offered_term_months 12), so the day before 2027-10-01. Uniqueness: fixed by the start date and the line's 12 months.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contracted_rent: Value 2175.21 (calculated). line_rent = 2,220.21 (the most recently delivered Standard Lease line, re-issued at step 11); early-renewal days counted from the scheduled delivery date because the program carries two lines = the program's 90 lead days, tier 75 or more -> discount 40.00; discount share 0.5 (exactly one violation notice fewer than 12 full months before 2026-07-20: 2026-02-10; the 2025-06-12 notice is 13 months old); on-time renewal credit 10.00 (no late fee in the window - the 2025-05-09 late fee is 14 months old - and autopay enrolled); parking bundle credit 15.00 (active Structured Garage Space); 2,220.21 - 40.00 x 0.5 - 10.00 - 15.00 = 2,175.21.

factor_trace: loyalty_cap_reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty lease): leases.move_in_date 2021-10-01 to the delivery date 2026-07-02 of the Standard Lease line in error = 57 full months -> tier '48 months or more' -> 0.025; baseline (no loyalty reduction, 0) would give 2264.76.

standing_cap_reduction (parameter, multi-source, lease): lease_payments returns dated fewer than 12 full months before 2026-07-20 = 0 (the 2025-05-06 return is 14 months old, near-miss) AND leases.autopay_enrolled = true -> tier 1 -> 0.005; baseline 0 would give 2229.12.
expiry_season_cap_reduction (parameter, date): term_end_date 2026-09-30 -> September -> tier 'March, April, September or October' -> 0.0025; baseline 0 would give 2224.66.

increase_relief_cap_reduction (parameter, history): term_rent_changes on the expiring term: 2045.00 -> 2140.00 = 4.6455 percent -> tier '3 percent or more but under 6 percent' -> 0.0025; baseline 0 would give 2224.66.

rent_period_cap_fitting (method, history/date): last rent change effective 2025-12-01 through term end 2026-09-30, both included = 304 days < 365 -> prorated: company cap 0.045 x 304/365 = 0.0374795; baseline (cap applies as it stands, 0.045) would give 2236.30.

plain bindings: renewal increase cap of the Standard Lease program 0.08; company cap = 0.08 - (0.025+0.005+0.0025+0.0025) = 0.045; community state CO has no statutory cap, so the effective cap = the rent-period cap 0.0374795; capped 12-month-equivalent rent = 2140.00 x 1.0374795 = 2220.2061; Standard Lease rent adjustment 0 percent adds 0; result = RND(2220.2061 + half-up guard, 2) = 2220.21.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: 48 months or more of continuous tenancy
no returned payment in the window AND autopay enrolled
term ends in March, April, September or October
increase of 3 percent or more but under 6 percent
rent period shorter than 365 days: prorated

factor_trace: early_renewal_discount (parameter, date): early-renewal days counted (90, see the clock factor) -> tier '75 days or more' -> 40.00 a month; baseline (no discount) would give 2195.21.

early_renewal_clock_start (method, history/date): after the re-issue the Standard Lease program carries two lines on the expiring term -> counted from the scheduled delivery date = the program's renewal offer lead days = 90; baseline (from the signing date 2026-07-20 to 2026-09-30 = 72 days, which earns the program discount 25.00) would give 2182.71.

violation_discount_share (parameter, cross-difficulty lease): lease_notices violation notices dated fewer than 12 full months before 2026-07-20 = 1 (2026-02-10; the 2025-06-12 notice is 13 months old, near-miss) -> tier 'exactly one' -> 0.5; baseline (all of the discount, 1.0) would give 2155.21.

edges.condition: The most recently delivered term_offers line for the expiring term's own term program carries an offered_rent no higher than the corrected offer rent of the renewal offer rules (the in-place contracted rent raised by the effective cap and adjusted by the program's rent adjustment).
edges.policy_source: The contracted rent of a like-program renewal is fixed only after the offer line standing for the renewing term program is priced within the effective cap of the renewal offer rules.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only Standard Lease (10-12 Months) line on the expiring term was delivered on 2026-07-02 at 2,311.20, which is the in-place rent 2,140.00 raised by the full 8 percent program cap; the effective cap on this world is 3.74795 percent (company cap 4.5 percent after the loyalty 2.5, standing 0.5, season 0.25 and relief 0.25 point reductions, prorated over a 304-day rent period), so the line stands above the effective cap and the corrected offer rent is 2,220.21.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The re-issue write delivers a second Standard Lease line on the expiring term dated 2026-07-20 at 2,220.21 (the corrected offer rent); the most recently delivered line for the program is then within the effective cap, line_rent reads 2,220.21 instead of 2,311.20 and renewing_lines becomes 2.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain (one prerequisite, no parallel edges), so there is exactly one topological order: the offer line re-issue (step 11) strictly before the renewal signing (step 13). Reversing them signs the renewal at a rent computed from the line in error (2,273.70) and from the wrong line, a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the re-issue (step 11) and replaying everything else: renewing_lines = 1, line_rent = 2,311.20, the early-renewal clock falls back to the signing date (72 days, program discount 25.00 x 0.5), so contracted_rent = 2,273.70 instead of 2,175.21; the terminal term_offers table also lacks the corrected line. Taken from the Step 5 sensitivity run (calc.py 0 [[11]]).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the renewal (the root problem). It quotes the letter's figure 2,311.20 as a plain fact already in initial_state, says she is not asking to negotiate, never says the line is wrong, never mentions a cap, a correction or a re-issue; her only reference to the correction is a passive reaction ('If the agent explains that the offer line has to be corrected or re-issued before you can sign, you say that is fine') that fires only after the agent says it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: sign_renewal_term_7151ccb7 reads the accepted offer line and the lease only to copy the term program, length and leaseholder, then creates the pending renewal term with whatever contracted_rent it is given; it never compares the line with any cap, never checks whether a corrected line exists and never returns an error. Called on the line in error it would sign at the figure passed. reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766 likewise just creates the new line with the rent passed.

request_alignment.claim: The resident asks to renew her lease on the same Standard Lease program for twelve months and to sign the renewal herself during the call.
evidence: user_scenario:you want to renew now, on the same Standard Lease program you are on today, this time for a full twelve months, and you would like to sign the renewal yourself during this call

gold_actions.business_effect: A corrected Standard Lease renewal offer line is delivered on the expiring term at 2,220.21, replacing for acceptance the line posted in error at 2,311.20.

request_binding.action_semantics: The offer-line correction is owed by the state of the records whatever the caller asks: the renewing program's line on a current term stands above the effective cap, and an offer above the cap is corrected before acceptance. It is the only write that re-prices an offer line; the renewal signing, the only other write, consumes the line.

discriminator.business_meaning: the like-program offer line priced above the effective renewal increase cap

stage_provenance.fact: The corrected line is delivered synchronously by this write; the line in error and the current term exist at the opening.

base_preconditions.condition: Tenure is measured across the whole chain of terms on the lease; the loyalty reduction of the renewal cap is read on the offer date (governs the renewal offer subject; no structured gate).
Renewal offers are delivered only on a term that is current.

gold_actions.business_effect: The resident signs a pending 12-month Standard Lease renewal term on her lease from 2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30 at 2,175.21 a month.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks to renew on the same program for twelve months and to sign herself; a renewal signing writes a new renewal term (term_create), distinct from a notice, an early termination or an offer correction.

evidence: user_scenario:you want to renew now, on the same Standard Lease program you are on today, this time for a full twelve months

discriminator.business_meaning: renew now, on the same Standard Lease program
evidence: user_scenario:you want to renew now, on the same Standard Lease program you are on today, this time for a full twelve months

stage_provenance.fact: The open offer line accepted is the corrected line delivered by step 11; the expiring current term exists at the opening.

base_preconditions.condition: A new term may be written only when the lease has no other term in pending status.
Tenure and transfers are measured across the chain of terms (governs term_create; no structured gate for this write).
A renewal may be signed only when the frozen date is no later than the offer date plus the offer's validity days.
The transfer rule governs term_create only for transfer terms; this write is a renewal term, so no transfer gate applies.
Month-to-month conversion governs term_create only for a term ending with no renewal and no notice; a signed renewal before term end prevents conversion.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A renewal may be signed only when the frozen date is no later than the offer date plus the offer's validity days.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Offer validity days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the offer date, and the offer can be accepted through the last counted day.

boundary_check.just_before: The corrected line is dated 2026-07-20 and is open for the Standard Lease validity of 30 days counted from the day after 2026-07-20, through 2026-08-19, which is also the last acceptance date written on it; at frozen date 2026-07-20 the line is open (a frozen date of 2026-08-20 would be one day past the counted days and could not be signed).
boundary_check.at_boundary: Signing on the last counted day, 2026-08-19, is allowed (inclusive); the handling date 2026-07-20 is the offer date itself. Both readings of the window (offer date plus validity days, and the written last acceptance date) give 2026-08-19 for the re-issued line.
